title: Last To Leave The Ferris Wheel Wins $250,000
description: 50 strangers rode one Ferris wheel for six days. Would you have stepped off for $100,000? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Okabe: 40-year-old Japanese game-show host, silver hair in a ponytail, white suit, black sunglasses, microphone
characters.Sora: 24-year-old Japanese nurse, brown hair in a low ponytail, light blue nurse scrubs, tired kind eyes
characters.Kenta: 35-year-old Japanese businessman, neat black hair, navy three-piece suit, expensive watch, calm smirk

scenes.say: 50 strangers, one Ferris wheel, and the last one still riding wins $250,000. Host Okabe adds one rule: every time the wheel stops, he pays you to step off.
scenes.video: [0-4s] A giant Ferris wheel at a seaside amusement park, 50 people crowd the boarding platform. [4-7s] Okabe in a white suit points a microphone at the camera with a pile of cash beside him. [7-10s] Cabins rise into the evening sky, faces pressed to the windows.

scenes.say: First stop, $2,000. 28 people step off right away, so 22 are left. A nurse named Sora stays, and she keeps staring at a photo of a boy in a hospital bed.
scenes.video: [0-4s] The wheel stops, Okabe fans out cash bills, a crowd rushes off the cabins. [4-7s] A counter on a big sign drops from 50 to 22. [7-10s] Inside a cabin, Sora holds a small photo of a little boy in a hospital bed.

scenes.say: Day two, $20,000 and a hot bath. 13 more quit, leaving 9. Sora's phone buzzes: the boy's surgery costs exactly $230,000. She does not move.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Rainy morning, Okabe holds up a towel and a stack of cash; contestants step off. [4-7s] The sign counter drops from 22 to 9. [7-10s] Close-up of Sora's phone showing a hospital bill for $230,000; she grips the seat.

scenes.say: Day four, $100,000. Five people take it, so only 4 remain: Sora, a teen gamer, a grandpa, and Kenta, a rich businessman who says he's only here for fun.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Okabe opens a briefcase full of cash; five people grab bundles and leave. [4-7s] The sign drops from 9 to 4. [7-10s] Kenta in a navy suit relaxes in his cabin, checking his gold watch with a smirk.

scenes.say: Day six, the grandpa and the gamer step off for $150,000 each. So it's Sora against Kenta, and through the glass, Kenta finally sees the photo of the boy.
scenes.video: [0-4s] The grandpa and the teen gamer walk off holding cash; the sign drops to 2. [4-7s] Two cabins side by side at the top of the wheel at sunset. [7-10s] Kenta looks across through the glass at Sora's photo of the boy; his smirk disappears.

scenes.say: Kenta steps off with $200,000, so Sora wins $250,000. Then Kenta hands her his cash too: 'For his recovery.' 50 strangers rode that wheel. Only one never rode for herself.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Kenta steps off the wheel and takes a stack of cash from Okabe; the sign drops to 1. [4-7s] Sora steps out crying as Okabe hands her a giant check. [7-10s] Kenta gives Sora his cash with a quiet bow; the Ferris wheel glows behind them.
